requirements.quote: proposal is invited under e-tender mode(2 bid system) from the Intending Technology Partner(TP) having proven technological capabilities in Advance Metering Infrastructure Solution (AMI) including necessary certifications for “Smart Energy Meters (Single Phase, Three Phase & LT-CT Operated three phase) meeting IS 16444 Standard” and ready to transfer the technology (ToT) for manufacturing by ITI as per terms & conditions enumerated below, may submit their proposal.
requirements.text: The bidder must have proven technological capabilities in AMI solutions, certifications for Smart Energy Meters meeting IS 16444, and readiness for technology transfer.

requirements.quote: Technical bid and Financial bid is to be submitted separately in the allotted sections in the Tender portal. Otherwise, the bids will be likely to be rejected.
requirements.text: The bidder must submit technical and financial bids separately in the designated sections of the tender portal.
The RFP is issued on October 10, 2024.
The last date for bidders to submit queries is October 17, 2024, at 15:00 Hrs.

requirements.quote: Upload of Reply to Bidder’s query 24.10.2024: 15:00Hrs
requirements.text: Replies to bidders' queries will be uploaded by October 24, 2024, at 15:00 Hrs.

requirements.quote: Due Date & Time for Submission of Proposal through Uni Wizard 30.10.2024: 17:00 Hrs
requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted through Uni Wizard by October 30, 2024, at 17:00 Hrs.

requirements.quote: Date & Time of opening of Proposals 31.10.2024: 15:00Hrs
requirements.text: Proposals will be opened on October 31, 2024, at 15:00 Hrs.
